items.description:
Title: TRADE: Riding Mower for Small Engine Repair (Carburetors)
Location: Lee's Summit / Lakewood
Body:
I am looking for a local small engine hobbyist or mechanic to service the carburetors on two of my small machines. In exchange for your time, labor, and parts, you can keep my 42" Troy-Bilt riding lawn mower for FREE.
What I need done:
1. Walk-Behind Lawn Mower: Has been sitting too long and has some gas supply hesitation issues. Needs the carburetor thoroughly cleaned out or replaced with a new one so it runs smoothly.
2. Power Washer: Also sitting too long with fuel issues. Needs the carburetor cleaned out or replaced with a new one.
What you get in exchange (FREE):
* A 42-inch Troy-Bilt Super Bronco Automatic Riding Lawn Tractor (Model 13AT609G766).
* It features a 21.0 HP Briggs & Stratton engine and an automatic transmission with foot pedal cruise control.
* Condition: It has been sitting in storage for 2 years. The body plastics and hood are completely intact. It DID start and run when it was parked, but it will need the standard battery/fuel refresh to get going again. It is a fantastic project machine to flip or keep, or a high-value source of components if you want to part it out.
Terms of the Trade:
* You must provide the labor and any necessary replacement parts/carburetors to get both my walk-behind mower and power washer running perfectly.
* You must bring your own tools and have a truck, trailer, or ramps to haul the riding mower away.
* The riding mower leaves with you once my two machines are up, running, and tested.
If you are a handy mechanic looking for an easy, high-value project mower in trade for a couple of hours of work, please reply with your availability and a phone number where I can reach you. Thanks!

items.title: Honeywell Cool Mist Humidifier - cleaning out storage
items.ai_notes: [Honeywell HUL520B Cool Mist Humidifier] Common humidifier, good for quick flip if clean.
items.description:
Honeywell Black HUL520B Mistmate Cool Mist Humidifier.
Setup & Filling
• Remove and invert the tank: Lift the water tank off the base using the carrying handle and turn it upside down.
• Remove the cap: Twist the tank cap toward the open lock symbol.
• Fill with cool water: Fill the 0.5-gallon tank with cool tap water. Do not use warm or hot water.
• Seal and replace: Confirm the black cap seal is in place, twist the cap to align the arrow with the lock symbol, and set the tank back onto the base.
Operating & Auto Shut-Off
• Plug in safely: Ensure the power knob is in the Off position, then plug the cord into a polarized 120V outlet using dry hands.
• Adjust mist output: Turn the power/mist knob clockwise to the highest setting to start misting. Once the room reaches a comfortable humidity level (40–60%), turn the knob counterclockwise to a lower setting.
• Position mist away from surfaces: Point the mist outlet away from walls, furniture, and bedding to prevent condensation.
• Auto shut-off: The unit shuts off automatically when the tank runs empty. Turn the knob off and unplug before refilling or cleaning.
Cleaning & Care
• Routine cleaning: Turn off and unplug the unit, empty remaining water from the tank and reservoir, and clean with distilled white vinegar (such as 2 cups undiluted white vinegar swished in the tank and drained into the reservoir per Honeywell's cleaning guidance), then rinse thoroughly with clean water so no detergent or vinegar residue remains.
• Storage: Dry all components completely before storing if you will not use the humidifier for more than a week.

How Your Serial Number Breaks Down
• Prefix (00402): Identifies the Suzuki DT4 2-stroke model series.
• Serial Number (826607): According to the Browns Point Marine serial number chart:
• 1988 models start at 00402-824522.
• 1989 models start at 00402-930692.
• Because 826607 falls right after 824522 (the first digit 8 also corresponds to the year ending in 8), your motor was built for the 1988 model year.
• Fuel & Oil Reminder: Because this is a 1988 2-stroke, it does not have oil injection. Mix TC-W3 2-stroke marine oil into your unleaded gasoline at 50:1 (2.6 fl oz of oil per 1 gallon of gas) before running it

Exact Eligible Models by Year
• 1964–1966 Chevrolet Impala / Caprice / Biscayne: These are most famously associated with full-size models like the Impala and Caprice, especially on sportier trim levels or convertibles where owners wanted a high-end wire-wheel aesthetic.
• 1965–1966 Chevrolet Chevelle / Malibu: A highly popular option for mid-size muscle cars, particularly the Chevelle Super Sport (SS) models.
• 1964–1966 Chevy II / Nova: While many compact Novas ran 13-inch variants, V8-equipped models ordered with upgraded 14-inch factory wheels used this exact package.

items.title: Sweet Purebred Female Maine Coon – 2 Years Old
items.ai_notes: [Purebred Female Maine Coon cat] Purebred cat. Resale of pets is highly variable and depends on local demand.
items.description:
Sweet Purebred Female Maine Coon – 2 Years Old
Nellie is a beautiful 2-year-old purebred female Maine Coon with the sweetest, easygoing personality. She loves being around her people and will happily follow you from room to room, watching whatever you’re doing. She’s playful, curious, and has that fun, quirky Maine Coon personality. She especially loves dipping her paws in water! She also enjoys cozy naps and will curl up on your lap for cuddles when she’s feeling relaxed.
She’s wonderful with people and children and gets along well with other cats. She’s a little cross-eyed, which makes her extra adorable, but she sees just fine.
Nellie is spayed, declawed, litter box trained, and has no known health issues or allergies. She received all her kitten vaccinations and will just need routine boosters.
Her beautiful, fluffy coat is currently growing back after a summer shave. She does great at the groomer but does require frequent brushing and regular grooming to keep her coat looking its best.
We love Nellie very much, but our busy household with dogs hasn’t been the best fit for her. She gets nervous when energetic dogs run toward her, although she’s never aggressive. We’re hoping to find her a quieter home where she can feel comfortable and enjoy all the attention and care she deserves.
Nellie must be kept indoors and would do best in a home without dogs or with calm, laid-back dogs that give her space.
She currently eats Purina ONE Sensitive Skin & Stomach dry food and uses Fresh Step Advanced Simply Unscented clumping litter.
She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, playful, and affectionate Maine Coon.
Rehoming fee: $750. Local pickup in Overland Park, Kansas. Venmo accepted at pickup.
Rehoming fee applies to ensure a serious, loving home.
If interested, please share a little about yourself, your household, and any other pets. Hoping to find the best fit for her!

EXCELLENT LIKE NEW CONDITION! Heavy dutyhome gym workout setup in great condition! The LeverGym is great for doing bench presses without a spotter, also great for isolateral, close grip, flat, decline, incline bench press, shoulder press, shrugs, and bent over rows! Includes:

I also have iron and rubber bumper plates, Olympic bars, iron and rubber dumbbells, kettlebells, benches, racks, bikes, weight vests, etc. just look at my other items or send me a message about them.
LeverGym Dimensions: 81.4" x 57.5" x 81.7"
The Powertec Workbench LeverGym is one of the most functional single station home gym systems ever created. The heavy duty isolateral lever arms can safely hold up to 500 lbs combined. The detachable workbench can be removed to perform a multitude of additional exercises.
The list of exercises is almost endless, especially with the wide variety of attachments that can be mounted to the workbench. New and Improved Angled stainless-steel weight horns, added resistance band pegs, extra press arm settings, removeable storage horns and improved padding material make the Levergym and even greater value. Bring home the ultimate home gym today.
WHAT CAN IT DO?
We have a full in-depth video that highlights at least 40 exercises that can be performed on the Workbench Levergym. View it on our YouTube channel!
THE LEVERAGE ADVANTAGE:
The use of lever arms creates the smoothest motion in any weight training machine and is the closest thing to free weights. The Lever arms have built-in safety stops that allow users to train to exhaustion without the use of a spotter. When finished, you simply set the weight down. This security provides the opportunity to achieve maximum muscle growth in the comfort of your own home.
POWER LIFTING ACCESS:
The utility bench can be detached from the Levergym to access additional exercises such as Squat, Calf, Dip, Shrug and Deadlift using the arms and Low-row using the lower cable access.
FULLY ADJUSTABLE BENCH DESIGN:
The Workbench's design provides additional stability and allows users to adjust the seating area and Back Rest Pads at different settings with ease thanks to its unique Ball Bearing Driven Carriage. (The bench has 9 horizontal positions, and 9 vertical positions, including decline, flat, and 7 incline positions. See 'Workbench FID Utility Bench' for more information on positions and angles).
EXPANDABLE WITH ACCESSORIES:
The bench includes the front tube adaptor that accepts all Powertec Workbench Attachments, and includes the preacher curl and leg extension/curl attachments!
TRUE WEIGHT LIFTED ON LEVERARMS:
The arms on the lever gym equate to 20 lbs. lifted. (10 lbs. each arm). The weight reduction due to the leverage is 20% of the total load plus the weight of the arms. For example - with 200 lbs. added to the Leverarms, you would minus 20% for the Leverarm weight distribution (160 lbs.) plus the weight of the arms (20lbs.). Therefore, 200 lbs. of weight would equate to a total 180 lbs. of perceived weight lifted.

items.title: 1970 Martin 00-21 12 Fret, Brazilian?
items.ai_notes: [1970 Martin 00-21 Acoustic Guitar] Vintage Martin guitars are high-value collectibles. Condition is excellent, though previous repairs are noted.
items.description:
For sale is a one owner Martin 00-21 from 1970. I purchased this guitar from the owner just over two years ago and have not had the opportunity to play it.
This guitar is in lovely condition with its original finish, I would say is in excellent condition. There are a few marks on the bout that are not very deep and should buff out. Almost no marks on the headstock, perhaps one or two string nicks, but that is it (see the photos). The tuners are original to the guitar and work well.
I would not hesitate to say that it would be difficult to locate as clean a 1970 guitar as this one. The frets are almost like new, but the back of the neck has a few light scratches and that is it. The action is pretty low, I'll post a measurement on that in a day or two.
The neck was reset by Martin about 12 years ago and also had the pick guard changed at that time. It appears there was a crack in the top that was addressed, but I can see no evidence of the repair. I assume the crack was under the pick guard  or there about, which was not unusual for this period of Martin guitars.
I believe that the guitar has a Brazilian back and sides, but Martin claims to have stopped using that material in 1968. We all know some surplus was used by Martin after 1968 and there are many stories expounding on this on the internet.
I sent photos to Martin and was on the phone with them. I had another Martin at the time from 1970 and sent them side by side photos of both, showing the dissimilarity of the two woods. The historian in Nazareth told me officially Martin stopped using the rarer wood in 1968, so their records state that Indian Rosewood was used on this guitar. I'll let you be the judge. Martin just wasn't using figured Indian like this at that time.
The description of the guitar from its previous owner is in the photos as is a copy of the original warranty card from 1970. This card  shows the purchase price of $350.00, the serial number and it is signed by Frank H. Martin....Those were the days.
The guitar comes in an almost new Martin case with 6 latches, this is one of their better cases. There is a light scuff on the top which I'll try to clean off. BTW, the guitar arrived to me with a broken High E string, and as I never played the guitar, I have left it as is. It has been well humidified the last two years plus it has. been in my care. The guitar is from a smoke and pest free home.
The guitar will be insured and packaged well. A signature will be required upon receipt.

items.title: Beatles pinball machine
items.ai_notes: [Stern The Beatles pinball machine] High-end collectible pinball machine.
items.description:
My price is firm so no offers please.
I never thought I'd have to say goodbye to my all-time favorite pinball machine because I'm moving and I have to downsize.  First of all I'm a huge fan of the Beatles.  This pinball machine encompasses the best of two worlds: old-school speed matched with new technology.  Essentially, this means you don't have to wait for the ball to essentially disappear as seen in the new games, but rather, there's no waiting for the ball to return.  Everything listed here is part of a package, so I won't separate any items from the sale.  This machine has not been played much since I am protecting it as a collectible.  My price is firm so no offers taken.
As the most influential band in music history, The Beatles is a property that people old and young can instantly recognize. To celebrate such an incredible legacy, Stern Pinball has created the first and only Beatles-themed pinball machine: The Beatles – Beatlemania.  Rated 8 out of 10 on Pinside.
Based upon a classic 1980 Stern pinball table called Seawitch, that older table has been completely re-themed to focus on The Beatles when they began their international “British Invasion” in 1964. The likenesses of John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr (the “Fab Four”) from this era are found on the cabinet, sporting their iconic blue suits. As the game layout is essentially the same as a classic game, this title feels like it came from the 1960’s, playing as a simple game that people of any skillset can enjoy.
The Beatles does more than just re-themes an old game with new artwork however. All of the electronics are modern, with Stern’s SPIKE-2 system managing the components; lights replaced with long-lasting LEDs; a sharp HD display built into the back box for vibrant animations and remastered clips and more. Custom speech has been provided for the game by the legendary disc jockey Cousin Brucie, who introduced The Beatles at New York’s Shea Stadium in 1964. The playfield has two new feature additions that elevate the game beyond Seawitch – first, a magnet at the top of the playfield; second, a spinning disc in the center of the playfield that looks like a vinyl record.
STERN PINBALL’S THE BEATLES PINBALL (GOLD EDITION) FEATURES

items.title: HEAVY Machinery, Equipment or Safe Moving Dollies
items.ai_notes: [Hydraulic Moving Dollies] Heavy-duty professional moving equipment. Very niche, slow-moving item.
items.description:
I have a matched pair of the heaviest hydraulic moving dollies you'll ever need.
Years ago I used these to move 10,000+ lb safes into retail businesses like banks and jewelry stores. I am retired now so they need to go.
I've used these to move huge machine shop equipment such as milling machines, lathes, etc. that I bought from Boeing. Put a short 4x4 across the forks and you can move any car or truck with ease.
These are pretty handy for a wide variety of moving jobs. Each dolly is rated at 5,000# / 10,000# total, but I know I've moved things much heavier with them. I'd guess they'd easily lift 15,000+#, and likely more. But they are only rated for 10,000#.
You can rent a pair in KCMO for $550.00 for the weekend (which I used to do before I bought these) or you can own this pair for only $1,250.00 obo.
Today, the new models which are much lighter weight run about $5,000 a pair from Granigers. These are unbelievably heavy! I think they weigh right at 500# for the pair.
Compared to a brand new set you'll see mine are the old, super over-built ones that are nearly indestructible.
You just set one dolly on each side of whatever you want to move, run a ratchet strap all the way around, pump the two bottle jacks and it will lift the work right up. Then the super heavy casters allow you to roll it all with one hand! They won't mar or damage tile floors so you can move equipment or safes without doing any damage.
This pair has paid for themselves 100x over. I've used them for 40 years and they still work like new. You won't ever wear these out. After you retire they will still be as good as new.
I have mine in storage and will get them out and photographed tomorrow if it doesn't rain, and post more pics.
The pic I have posted is from Grainer's web site. Mine look just like this, only more beefy and wider.
I think you'll find that you soon be thinking: 'How did I ever get along without these'?
You'll have to load them. I can't do heavy lifting anymore so bring a friend.
Pickup near 17th street north & Broadway at my storage lot.

items.title: Boer Bucks
items.ai_notes: [Boer buck] Valued one of the three bucks listed.
items.description:
I have three proven bucks that are looking for new pastures! The older two bucks I've used the past two seasons and have been proven to be good herd sires. The younger dapple, has also confirmed bred a handful of does for me that are set to kid in a few weeks. They are most definitely in their working clothes, they were breeding for me all summer and fall. I'm keeping back their daughters and I don't need four bucks, or else I'd be keeping them.
First is a coming two year fullblood red dapple buck. He's going to be an absolutely massive mature buck. He's already 250+ lbs when he's not in rut. He's long, he's gentle, and he is out of a long line of dappled genetics.
Second is a coming three year old fullblood buck. His sire is the *ENNOBLED* PAINT IT BLACK buck from Regel boer goats. His kids have been absolutely stout from front to back with bone for days. Hes a hands off type of buck but not hard to catch either.
Third is a commercial two and a half year old buck. He has sired 15+ kids for me and all of them have been dappled in some sort. He's a big guy, easy on people and fence.
These are great bucks in their own ways, they're all easy keepers and know how to work. Garden City MO.

Taking reservations for one pick boar and one pick gilt; the other boys will be castrated as feeders. Ready end of December. They will be trained on electric hog net and eating hay and mineral/grain.
Idaho Pasture Pigs are amazing foragers with an upturned snout like their Kune Kune ancestors but bred to finish out quicker, around 10-12 months. Step back into the golden age of turn-of-the-century holiday craftsmanship with this magnificent, fully complete 31-piece collection from Thomas Pacconi Classics. Released as part of the highly celebrated "Museum Thomas Series" Millennium Edition (1900–2000), this set pays homage to a hundred years of European glassmaking heritage. During the mid-to-late 19th and early 20th centuries, hand-blown glass ornaments were crafted by master glassblowers in Germany, Eastern Europe, and Italy, utilizing specialized clay molds and liquid silver solutions to create lightweight, reflective mercury glass treasures.
Thomas Pacconi captured this exact nostalgic aesthetic, recreating the charm of antique heirloom ornaments for modern collectors. Every ornament in this collection was hand-blown using traditional glass artistry, lined with reflective metallic finishes, and finished with meticulous hand-painted enamel and glitter detail work

items.description:
Young Katahdin Breeding Rams   Purebred - NO papers - but quality bloodlines.  Two available, asking $450 each.  Take your pick or buy them both.  Available the week of Thanksgiving as they are being put to use here currently.
Ram 1 is dark brown bay with some white splashes.  Twin Born 3/9/26.  Mom is a two year old red ewe with black and white spots and dad was a loud brown calico.
This is a nice THICK sheep.  He was born straight and strong, up and nursing in minutes.  This nice boy weaned at 54 pounds in 63 days gaining around .70 of a pound per day on mom’s plentiful milk as a twin and sister was of equal size.  Fed on creep for about a month following weaning and on nothing but grass since then, Obe has grown up to be a really nice ram.  So nice I decided to use him on my unrelated ewes before selling him this year.   He should produce some really nice lambs for next year.
Ram 2 is black with white head spots.  He was born a triplet 3/23/26 but raised as a twin.  Again, up and at ‘em right from the start.  Mom is experienced and colored just like her son.  She regularly throws LOUD pintos and nice fancy lambs.
This boy is long and balanced… again so nice I decided to use him before moving him on.  He weaned at 47 pounds in 60 days – as a triplet – gaining around .52 pounds per day.  He has just gotten nicer as he has grown out.
BOTH boys have sweet dispositions and nice feet.  I almost never have to trim feet with my flock.  They both the vitality and parasite resistance that I strive to breed for over the years.  Neither has needed any chemical interventions.  They should both shed quick and slick, just like their mothers do.  Our ewes regularly triplet and have milk and mothering ability so that they typically raise all their own babies without assistance.
Katahdins are hair sheep... meaning they don't require shearing... They shed!  Bred for meat and milk.  These boys have everything you want to add to your flock without the extra cost of registration papers.  Long bodied, thick through the loin, parasite resistance, refined heads, excellent coat, calm temperament, fast growth from a milky mom and plenty of color in their genetics...  Black, red and lots of spots! They should throw some nice colors in their lambs.
Interested?  Contact me via chat or email include your phone number for a call back.  Come take a look.  Available after November 20.  No delivery. Cash and carry only.

items.title: Boss Laser LS-1630 70W CO2 Laser Engraver/Cutter + Chiller, Compressor
items.ai_notes: [Boss Laser LS-1630 70W CO2 Laser] Professional laser engraver. Niche industrial equipment, slow to sell but high value.
items.description:
Up for sale is a Boss Laser LS-1630 CO2 laser engraving and cutting system, complete with its cooling, air-assist, and exhaust equipment. It's been kept indoors in a climate-controlled commercial building and is in clean, well-kept condition. We purchased in 2023 but quickly discovered it wouldn't meet our needs. We held onto in case we could come up with a work around. Very little tube useage.
Machine features
70W CO2 laser tube [confirm the tube label, since 105W was an option]
Ruida-style digital control panel with LCD, analog mA ammeter, and USB flash-drive port for running files without a PC
Connects to a PC by USB or Wi-Fi, and works with RDWorks or LightBurn [note whether a LightBurn license is included]
Motorized Z-table for materials up to 8" tall
Honeycomb bed and knife-blade slat bed, both included
Pass-through doors on the front, back, and sides for oversized material
Red-dot pointer for alignment and an air-assist laser head
Pull-out collection tray beneath the work bed
Safety interlocks, key switch, emergency stop, and interior light
Heavy steel cabinet on locking casters
Included accessories
Industrial water chiller [add the model, likely CW-3000 or CW-5000]
California Air Tools ultra-quiet air compressor for air assist
Inline exhaust fan with ducting
Original Boss Laser Operator's Manual
Boss Laser alignment tool kit
Toolbox, power cords, and accessories
Dimensions (per manufacturer): about 65.75" W × 38.5" D × 43.5" H. Work area - I believe the LS-1630 is 36" × 24"
Condition: The machine is fully functional. Cosmetic wear is minimal. The exhaust fan housing has some discoloration from normal use, and the honeycomb bed shows typical residue. Please see the photos.
Shipping and pickup: This is a heavy item (several hundred pounds). Local pickup is welcome in Leavenworth, KS. Freight shipping is available: the machine will be palletized, and the buyer pays freight. A forklift, dock, or liftgate is needed at delivery.
Tips for the listing:
Category: Business & Industrial > CNC, Metalworking & Manufacturing > Laser Engravers & Cutters.
Item specifics: Brand Boss Laser, Model LS-1630, Laser Type CO2, Power 70W.
Photos: Add a shot of the tube's wattage label, the chiller's model plate, and the machine running or a finished sample if you have one. Buyers at this price point want proof it works.
Pricing: The flyer lists a new price starting at $7,997, before the chiller and other add-ons. Check eBay's "Sold" filter for LS-1630s to see what they actually go for used, and consider enabling Best Offer.

items.description: John deere z335e 42 inch, 20 hp zero turn. Is a trade in, therefore sold as is. However, it does work. 275 hours on it. The issues ive noticed are that the valve covers are leaking. And the front casters seize up and they need new bearings or bushings, or whatever they put in there. Has a good battery and decent seat. Thus far the tires have held air fine. I have ran the mower a few times and all seems to work. The challenge is the fact that the fronts dont rotate properly. Likely model	Royal Copenhagen 3556 Boy with Umbrella

Country	Denmark
Height	Approximately 7 inches
Material	Hand-painted glazed porcelain

- Three blue waves: Represent Denmark's three principal waterways.
- Blue initials: Likely the individual porcelain painter's signature.

items.title: Complete Playmobil Fort Bravo Set 3773 + Extras (Western, Civil War)
items.ai_notes: [Playmobil Fort Bravo set 3773] Vintage toy set, appears complete with many extras. Niche collector item.
items.description:
I played with this when I was four and five and six and reassembled it for the photos you see: Every Fort Bravo piece represented in the instructions is present. On that basis, I consider it complete. However those stickers that were not applied to the fort by my parents and I back in the day—such as those saying "Fort Randall" and the Union Jacks—are not present. Also there is no box.
There are also many extras from what I assume were related Playmobil sets, one of which my research tells me might me Camp Thunder (3870). There is a frontiersman who carries a knife, a masked bandit and his bag, Indians/Native Americans, their accoutremont (cookware, a fire, horses, tapestries, head feathers, a shoe, bows and arrows and quivers), white civilians, a wagon, a carriage, oxen, horses, some of which have saddles to which a sleeping bag and a rifle can be attached, cacti, plants, a withered winter tree, a bison, many rifles—lever action and caplock—pistols, knives, holsters, scarves, bugles, chests, powder bags, a dog, wrist cuffs, cups, a table, a chair and more. I am including three damaged holsters: One is severed but could be glued together. Two others are missing a section but are able to sit on a figurine's waist. Please see the photos. (I apologize for the shallow depth of field.)
In the plastic bag are surplus building joints.
Included are a few pieces whose purpose I can't understand, such as the yellow disc on of the silver tools placed by the cannon. I really don't think it relates to Fort Bravo, but I'm including it anyway.
The teepee has foxing on it. Perhaps it can be washed off.
You can have the wooden boards if you like.
Please ask any questions you may have.
Smoke-free home.

items.title: 1993 Hooker Headers ( # 2100 ) & Muffler for Small-Block "Street Rod"
items.ai_notes: [Hooker Headers #2100] Used headers with one missing flange; requires welding/repair.
items.description:
Offering these used 1993 Hooker headers and new "California Turbo" muffler.
According to the Hooker website, these 2100 headers fit small-block Gen 1 Chevrolet V-8 engines from the 4.3L (262-265CID) through the 4.6L (283CID), the 5.0L (302-305-307CID), the 5.4L (327CID), the 5.7L (350CID), to the 6.6L (400CID).  Hooker recommends these for "1923-1949 Street Rods."  According to Hooker's Footnotes, these "Will fit Corvette D-port aluminum angle plug heads;" they "Will not fit angle plug heads;" (non-Corvette-D-port iron heads?) and "These headers will not fit any factory application with side engine mounts, including 1963-82 Corvette."
Photo 1 shows the pair of headers and the NOS muffler.
Photo 2 shows the header which is missing its flange.  It appears to have been ground off at the inner weld.  It is the header dated "05 93" with the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the head-side flange (Photo 4).
Photo 3 shows the collector portions of the headers.
Photo 5 shows the "08 93" date and the 2100 Hooker Part Number on the header which still has its collector flange.  The flange has a 3-1/2"-diameter bolt-circle, with 3/8" bolt holes on a triangular pattern.
Photos 6 & 7 show apparent hammer marks on the headers that a previous owner likely made for clearance.
Photo 8 shows the "Hooker Super Competition" ID plate welded to the header without the flange.
And Photo 9 shows the NOS "California Turbo" muffler by American Exhaust Industries, Inc., 7040 Lankershim Blvd., N. Hollywood, CA, 91605.  Overall length including pipes is 24-5/8"; flanged inlet pipe is 2-1/4" ID x 9-3/4" long (triangular-mount 3/8" flange-bolt holes are on 3-7/8" bolt-circle diameter); oval 10-1/4" x 4-3/4" case is 13-1/2" long overall; and outlet pipe is 2-1/2" ID.  Muffler carton says "Muffler case heavy gauge galvanized steel double wrapped for double protection" and "Triple chamber design reduces back pressure and improves engine performance."
The muffler includes the flange gasket and bolts; there are no gaskets or hardware with the headers.
The $195.00 asking price is both fair and firm. Please don't contact me wasting my time and yours trying to haggle on the price. If I wanted a haggle price, I would have listed it for $250.00, and you would have felt good to get it for $195.00.

items.title: Two Adult Ball Pythons in need of a new home
items.ai_notes: [Ball Python with tank] Includes snake, tank, and decor; rehoming pets is a niche market.
items.description:
I have two ball pythons that I need to rehome due to changing circumstances.
One is a four-foot long female, and I believe her morph is called Banana Het Clown. She's currently living in a tank that is 36Lx18Wx16H. I'm asking a rehoming fee of $75 for the snake, and I can also give you the tank and all its decor along with her for a total of $125. She is very explorative and loves being brought out of her tank to hang out with her person. She's a bit head-shy, but for the most part she's perfectly comfortable with being handled, carried around the house, and so on.
The other snake is a male who is probably around 2-2.5 feet in length, but he is currently in his hide and I don't want to stress him out just to get a measurement. His morph is something along the lines of Desert Mojave Keyhole. His tank is approximately 31Lx16Wx15H. The rehoming fee is the same for him -- $75 for the snake, $125 total for him, the tank, and the decor. He's slightly shyer than my girl, so it's all the more exciting to see him exploring. He does occasionally like to be pulled out, but generally he's content to sit in his hide and stare at his people. He's very sweet, and he does take well to gentle, slow, and consistent handling.
Both of these snakes were originally my partner's, but we recently separated and I don't have the means to continue caring for them on my own due to my disability. I'm located in the Wyandotte area and would need you to come pick them up, as I am unable to drive. Neither of them have ever struck at a hand, and they both eat frozen-thawed rodents, not live.
I do love these guys, so if you reach out, please tell me a little bit about your experience and/or knowledge of snake care. I just want them to go to a good home. Thank you!

items.title: Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N Premium - Never Powered On - New Old Stock
items.ai_notes: [Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N UMPC] Rare collector's item, but untested and missing the proprietary charger.
items.description:
The one nobody else has: a 2007 Sony VAIO VGN-UX390N that has never been powered on. Not once.
Bought new, taken out of the box, and put away. The AC adapter got lost somewhere along the way, and the unit itself has spent its whole life stored in its soft carry cases inside a dry, cool suitcase. No use, no wear, no stories - because it never had a first day.
The real collector spec: 4.5-inch touchscreen, slide-out keyboard, Intel Core Solo 1.33GHz, 1GB RAM, SSD storage, fingerprint reader, front and rear cameras. A $2,500 machine in 2007 and still the coolest UMPC Sony ever made.
INCLUDED: the UX390N unit, battery, docking station / port replicator with its cover, both soft carry cases, stylus, and the mounting bracket kit still in its bag. Third photo shows the underside - model stickers, service tag, and Windows XP Professional COA.
NOT INCLUDED, stated plain: the AC adapter and the retail box. The adapter it needs is the Sony VGP-AC16V13 - it must be 16V. Generic 19.5V VAIO chargers can damage it. Replacements run about $25.
WHY IT IS SOLD UNTESTED: powering it on to test would spend the one thing that makes it rare - it has never been on. The battery is 19 years old; assume it is dead, every buyer of these does, and it is priced in. Sold as-is as a collectors piece.
$695, offers welcome. Trades considered: a high-end metal detector (Minelab Equinox 800/900 class) straight across, or a top-end full-auto BB rifle plus cash. Local pickup in Northland Kansas City, public meetup, cash.

items.ai_product: 1970s Jack in the Box clown face wall plaque
items.title: 2 RARE ORIGINAL 1970 Jack in Box Clown Vintage 3D molds from the claycomo restau
items.ai_notes: [1970s Jack in the Box clown face wall plaque] Rare vintage restaurant decor pieces; niche collector market.
items.description:
Authentic pair of 1970s Jack in the Box commercial interior sign faces.These are true vacuum-formed 3D plastic architectural pieces rescued directly from the building demolition of the Claycomo, MO location (64119) in 1979. Kept indoors in the family ever since.
One is a 14-inch circular face, one is a 15-inch rounded-square face.
These molded vacuum-formed plastic clown face plaques were part of the interior decor scheme used in late-1960s and 1970s Jack in the Box restaurants.
​Where They Were Located in the Restaurant
​Dining Area Wall Decor: These unlit 3D relief medallions were mounted as decorative wall ornaments throughout the customer seating and dining booth areas.
​Trash Receptacle / Counter Surround Panels: In many 1970s store layouts, identical vacuum-formed plastic clown faces were embedded or mounted directly into the front fascia of wood-grain trash enclosure units, tray-return counters, and low partition dividers surrounding the booth seating areas.
​Drive-Thru / Order Prep Dividers: They were also inset into the interior wall panels separating the kitchen/order prep lines from the front lobby.
Because these plastic plaques were non-illuminated, vacuum-molded embellishments mounted flush onto wall paneling or millwork, construction crews remodeling or demolishing the original red-roof buildings in 1979 often had to cut or unscrew them directly out of the surrounding wood framing and wallboard
Colors are incredibly bright and vibrant. A few minor hairline cracks at the bottom of the green collar on one sign, but structurally very sound for 1970s plastic.
WILL NOT SHIP due to the fragile nature of the vintage plastic.
Cash only on pickup. Thank you for your interest. 😊

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors memorabilia bundle] Niche car memorabilia bundle for a defunct vehicle project.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!

The JOYO Splinter JF-21 is an analog distortion and fuzz pedal modeled after a Rat-style circuit, featuring three knobs and two toggle switches for tonal shaping. CLASSIC DISTORTION & FUZZ HYBRID: All-analog design blends fuzz and distortion for thick, saturated, aggressive tone. From tight crunch to raw roaring fuzz. First distortion pedal for guitarists—compact yet solid, great sound for home practice and small gigs
FAT & MOSFET TOGGLE — TWO INDEPENDENT VOICINGS: FAT adds thick low-end for heavy riffs and full solos. MOSFET switches clipping diodes for softer, smoother vintage sound; MOSFET off uses silicon clipping for brighter, more aggressive modern edge. Difference is most noticeable at higher DISTORTION settings
3-KNOB CONTROL — DISTORTION, FILTER & VOLUME: DISTORTION sweeps from edge-of-breakup grit to saturated fuzz (start ~9 o’clock for crunch, past noon for aggressive metal). FILTER rolls off highs clockwise for darker tone, counter-clockwise for brighter cut. VOLUME from unity gain to amp-pushing boost. The pedal is like new and has barely been used. $26.00

items.description:
Used Johnson Millenium Stereo 150 Digital Modeling Guitar Combo Amp in Excellent Condition. Comes with  factory amp cover, carry case for J-12 foot controller and J-3 foot switch, both pedals are included along with the users manual. Looks new! I have owned this for about 24 years now and didn’t use it very much. There are several factory settings that sound great and you can dial in your own settings.
From the Johnson website: "The Johnson Millennium is the world's first Tube Integrated Modeling Amplifier. The Millennium can easily emulate the most sought-after vintage and modern guitar amps in the world. If you are in need of effects processing, the JM150's full function signal processing section lets you add up to 4 studio quality effects with total control over all parameters. Powered by 150 watts through 2 Celestion Vintage 30 loudspeakers.
Dual preamp design
Two 12AX7 tubes
150 watt stereo power amp section
True amplifier and effects morphing
Up to 4 studio quality effects at once
Full MIDI implementation
Chromatic tuner
S-DISC II processing power
Line Level speaker compensated XLR outputs
J-3 Multi-function footswitch included
J-12 Foot Controller included
Analog, digital, and tube circuitry, combined to give you the convenience of modern technology coupled with the tones of vintage circuitry. Johnson Amplification has real tubes. Another reason for the accurate modeling is that they examine the frequency responses, and the EQ curves of classic amps. All of that data is then stored in the appropriate models for instant recall.
Easy access to the sounds of your favorite tones is what Tube Integrated Modeling Amplification is all about. There is no easier way to access those tones than with a Johnson amp. If you want the sound of a British Stack... push a button. If you want the sound of a vintage American combo...push a button. It's just that easy. Johnson Amplification also provides effects processing that those historic amps didn't include. Adding effects is as easy as pressing a button. Johnson amps also include dozens of user and factory presets. Recalling any preset is as easy as using a footswitch, or turning a knob.

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car project; value is purely for collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional T-shirt] Valued the T-shirt as the primary item; the Elio project is defunct, making this a niche collectible for automotive enthusiasts.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker "NEW Lower Price"
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise lot] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car company. Very limited market.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $25 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] A niche historical railroad tool; no price provided in the listing.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Vintage UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche collectible item; value is highly subjective.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car company; value is purely subjective to collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable. Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer. If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available. Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer. Randy 913 6three6-6766 . Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad track inclinometer] Antique railroad tool with no price listed in the description. Value is highly dependent on collector interest.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track inclinometer] Niche collectible item. Value depends entirely on finding the right railroad enthusiast.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] These are niche collectibles for a defunct car company. Value is subjective to enthusiasts.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production!  The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg.  Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention.  I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars.  Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure.  These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that.  I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale.  I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other.  Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept.  You will NOT find these items offered very seldom.  Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable.  Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer.  If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available.  Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer.  Randy  913 6three6-6766 .  Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.ai_notes: [Project car] This is a wanted (ISO) post for a project car.
items.description:
As a kid I grew up going to car shows on the weekends with my grandpa and we both loved muscle cars. I’m in my 30s now and would like a project car to work on with my dad. He’s a mechanic, so as long as the body is straight and isn’t rusted out we can make it work.
I heard so many stories growing up from the older guys at the car shows about how they acquired their cars. Many people had stories about an older neighbor or family friend who had a classic car that they gave to them or sold to them for cheap because they knew the person loved cars. I figured it’s worth a shot to see if anyone wanted to pass that kindness forward to a true lifetime classic car lover. I’d love to fix something up and take it to car shows with my dad while I still can. Thanks for taking the time to read this.

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors promotional merchandise bundle] Niche automotive memorabilia for a defunct car company. Value is purely subjective to collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable. Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $30 for all of the items or a very serious offer. If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available. Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer. Randy 913 6three6-6766 . Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.title: Very nice young roo, fayoumi mix, very good flock roo
items.ai_notes: [Fayoumi mix rooster] Live animal; price is not stated.
items.description:
I got a set of chicks that were supposed to be Fayoumi but are mixes. Fayoumi are an Egyptian breed that is resistant to Marek's, which I wanted to add into my flock. We're keeping the hen (in one of the pictures) but the roo needs a home. He's not people-friendly, but also not at all aggressive. At 8 months he's already shown signs of being an excellent flock roo. He courts, he tidbits, he escorts. When the girls say No, he listens and goes to court another hen. He guards, he's alert, and he's protective.
He's not a large roo, and he has a very large comb. Great for hot weather, not so great for winter. I'd like to find him a good home with a flock. He's got good genes and excellent flock-roo behavior, and he hasn't been at all aggressive with people. He's been around dogs and ducks and we've had no issues.
I'm in no hurry to find him a home but he's really come into his voice. Our other roo is ALSO a good flock roo and about half as loud, so he gets to stay. Our little fancy beautiful boy needs to leave. He's small and too good a roo for eating; I'd really like him to land with a flock esp. with Fayoumi genetics.

items.ai_notes: [Dog rehoming] This is a pet rehoming post, not a for-sale item.
items.description:
Good evening.
Due to extreme personal injuries with an undetermined recovery timeline I need to rehome my 12-year old dog Zeus. He’s indestructible, acts like a puppy, and I think he will live forever. This dog has literally and regularly eats everything he shouldn’t and goes pooping around like it’s another Tuesday. We have survived eating a 16 piece bucket of chicken bones from KFC, half a party tray of lasagna, loaded jalepeño cheesy bread from dominoes, 2 lbs of dove dark chocolate, eating onions like they are apples, peaches (pit and all), entire loaves of bread before they can be put up… if it’s within his reach it’s his.
He has absolutely ZERO concept of personal space or belongings. He doesn’t eat personal belonging any more because he found joy in eating everything else within reach. He loves to be in your space and trip you up when walking because he’s so happy to be with you, and he makes the ultimate snuggle buddy. He will snuggle you under or over the covers, but he prefers to start underneath until he gets too hot and then emerges panting like he ran a marathon.
He’s very friendly and cares about his humans. When he sees you are sad he always comes to comfort you, and he will wake you up when you are having nightmares to make sure you are ok. And he just loves people in general, but I make sure he’s not around babies. He also doesn’t do well around other pets, and I can explain later in person. He loves to help cook (aka eating everything you drop or throw to him), but be careful because he can be so quiet you will trip over him if you aren’t paying attention.
He LOVES to ride in the car but he has to be restrained. He WILL jump out if he sees something of interest. He also gets so excited about car rides he will have an “excite poop” in the car even if he already pooped right before hand. I’ve learned that the hard way, so I stop less than three minutes afterwards so he can poop again so we have a stink free ride.
He’s does NOT do well with other dogs/cats (I can explain later) and with how exuberant he is around humans I’m very careful with him around children but he has a knack for understanding injuries with the elderly, but I still exercise caution).
He’s the best of the best and has been my best friend for a decade, but with my declining health and physical abilities, he deserves to be with someone who can give him the very best life. He is a German shepherd/husky/pit mix. He’s got the very best of all three breeds. He’s so friendly, he doesn’t believe in stranger danger because everyone is his new best friend he hasn’t met yet (but he DOES know bad people and has warned me away from a few).
He would be amazing for a single person who can give unlimited love, or for a couple who aren’t in a rush to have kids.
He’s my best friend and it breaks my heart to re-home him, but he deserves a better life than I can offer him at this time. Please message me if you are interested.

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR Inclinometer] Highly collectible railroad antique; value is subjective and depends on finding the right collector.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks
